typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		setid as string,
		location as string,
		effdt as date,
		eff_status as string,
		descr as string,
		descrshort as string,
		building as string,
		floor as string,
		sector as string,
		address1 as string,
		address2 as string,
		address3 as string,
		address4 as string,
		city as string,
		state as string,
		postal as string,
		estabid as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT [setid]       ,[location]       ,[effdt]       ,[eff_status]       ,[descr]       ,[descrshort]       ,[building]       ,[floor]       ,[sector]       ,[address1]       ,[address2]       ,[address3]       ,[address4]       ,[city]       ,[state]       ,[postal]       ,[estabid]              from    (select  [setid]       ,[location]       ,[effdt]       ,[eff_status]       ,[descr]       ,[descrshort]       ,[building]       ,[floor]       ,[sector]       ,[address1]       ,[address2]       ,[address3]       ,[address4]       ,[city]       ,[state]       ,[postal]       ,[estabid]          ,r=row_number() over (partition by location order by effdt desc,eff_status asc)    FROM [ps_hcm].[ps_location_tbl]) r_location   where r=1',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource	source(output(
		location_key as integer,
		setid as string,
		location as string,
		effdt as date,
		eff_status as string,
		descr as string,
		descrshort as string,
		building as string,
		floor as string,
		sector as string,
		address1 as string,
		address2 as string,
		address3 as string,
		address4 as string,
		city as string,
		state as string,
		postal as string,
		estabid as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from hr.dim_location',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
OLEDBSource,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(OLEDBSource@location == LookupLKPTABLE@location,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup select(mapColumn(
		setid = OLEDBSource@setid,
		location = OLEDBSource@location,
		effdt = OLEDBSource@effdt,
		eff_status = OLEDBSource@eff_status,
		descr = OLEDBSource@descr,
		descrshort = OLEDBSource@descrshort,
		building = OLEDBSource@building,
		floor = OLEDBSource@floor,
		sector = OLEDBSource@sector,
		address1 = OLEDBSource@address1,
		address2 = OLEDBSource@address2,
		address3 = OLEDBSource@address3,
		address4 = OLEDBSource@address4,
		city = OLEDBSource@city,
		state = OLEDBSource@state,
		postal = OLEDBSource@postal,
		estabid = OLEDBSource@estabid,
		location_key = location_key
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LookupSelect
LookupSelect split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> LookupIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
LookupIsMatch@Match sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		{} = Param_6)) ~> OLEDBCommand
LookupIsMatch@NotMatch sink(input(
		estabid as string,
		address3 as string,
		address2 as string,
		city as string,
		address1 as string,
		effdt as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		building as string,
		descr as string,
		descrshort as string,
		setid as string,
		location as string,
		address4 as string,
		state as string,
		postal as string,
		floor as string,
		sector as string,
		eff_status as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		estabid,
		address3,
		address2,
		city,
		address1,
		effdt,
		building,
		descr,
		descrshort,
		setid,
		location,
		address4,
		state,
		postal,
		floor,
		sector,
		eff_status)) ~> OLEDBDestination
